name: ideaprompt
description: Turn rough product or website ideas into refined briefs, practical implementation plans, or reviewed coding-agent execution prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Turn rough ideas into reviewed build-ready prompts
interface.longDescription: Clarify an idea, scope a first release, plan the build and hand off a reviewed execution prompt to a coding agent. Uses the host assistant only; no API key, MCP server or website required.
defaultPrompt: Use $ideaprompt to turn my idea into a practical plan and a reviewed execution prompt.
